Tune with the coupon"},"lead_c":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"lead-in chamfer size on the lip"},"edge_chamfer":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_n":{"value":6,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"count","note":"grip scallops"},"scallop_d":{"value":5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_depth":{"value":1.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_step":{"value":0.1,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"lip interference step between the three coupon pockets"},"coupon_floor":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_pitch":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"Flat top face (the face the bolt tip pokes out of) on the bed; nut pocket opens upward. z=0 is the bed.","use_orientation":"Flipped over: pocket/nut side facing the work surface, flat grip face up.","code":"import math
def hexd(af):
    return af / math.cos(math.radians(30))

def build(p):
    H = p.knob_h
    R = p.knob_d / 2.0
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(R).extrude(H).edges().chamfer(p.edge_chamfer)
    # grip scallops
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_n)):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / p.scallop_n
        rc = R + p.scallop_d / 2.0 - p.scallop_depth
        cut = (cq.Workplane('XY').center(rc * math.cos(a), rc * math.sin(a))
               .circle(p.scallop_d / 2.0).extrude(H))
        body = body.cut(cut)
    # bolt through hole
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d + p.bolt_hole_clear) / 2.0).extrude(H))
    # nut pocket (opens at z=H)
    depth = p.nut_h + p.pocket_depth_extra
    z0 = H - p.lip_t - depth
    pocket = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0)
              .polygon(6, hexd(p.nut_af + p.pocket_clear)).extrude(depth + 0.01))
    body = body.cut(pocket)
    # retaining lip opening (smaller hex) with lead-in
    lip_af = p.nut_af - p.lip_interf
    lip = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z0 + depth - 0.01)
           .polygon(6, hexd(lip_af)).extrude(p.lip_t + 0.02 - p.lead_c))
    body = body.cut(lip)
    lead = (cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H - p.lead_c)
            .polygon(6, hexd(lip_af)).workplane(offset=p.lead_c + 0.01)
            .polygon(6, hexd(lip_af + 2 * p.lead_c)).loft())
    body = body.cut(lead)
    return body

    return plate
